failure_clusters.does_not_prove: That the strategy is completely broken; it performs exceptionally well in neutral regimes (profit factor of 3.12, net_R of +64.92R).
evidence: Long regime profit factor of 0.0437 with net_R of -117.56R
Short regime profit factor of 0.0544 with net_R of -100.42R
Neutral regime profit factor of 3.1266 with net_R of +64.92R

hypotheses.falsification_test: Run a historical simulation of S03 restricting entries strictly to the neutral regime. Falsified if the net R improvement does not exceed 150R or if trade retention drops below 40% of the total sample.
hypotheses.single_axis_change: Restrict strategy execution to neutral regimes only, disabling entries during long and short regimes.
hypotheses.why: The strategy exhibits extreme regime dependency. Long and short regimes generate massive net losses (-217.98R combined) with near-zero profit factors, while the neutral regime is highly profitable.
To serve as a baseline control against the primary regime filter hypothesis.
